Hands-on training programmes and workshops, separate from my regular semester courses.

## Security

### [Web Application Security](web-security/index.html)

Invited sessions in the **Training of Trainers Program on Cybersecurity** under PM-SETU, conducted by E&ICT Academy, IIT Guwahati.

- **Session date:** 20 November 2026, 10:00 am – 5:00 pm
- **Program dates:** 15–25 November 2026
- **Venue:** E&ICT Academy IIT Guwahati Skilling and Computing Facility, Technology Complex

Topics: web application architecture, OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, SQL injection, cross-site scripting (XSS), authentication vulnerabilities, session hijacking, and secure coding practices. [Session slides and student worksheets](web-security/index.html) are available.
